note: DRAFT, UNREVIEWED. No Hebrew teacher has checked this placement check, and no learner has taken it. Every number below is an untested guess, not a validated cutoff. Hebrew text is never written here: all items are drawn at run time from data/letters, data/pronunciation/niqqud.json, data/vocab/words.json, data/corpus/registry.json and data/curriculum/lessons.json. The unpointed items take words from data/vocab/words.json and remove the vowel marks in code; a word whose unpointed spelling matches another word in that file is never used.
